clauses.quote: Teachers who take no personal leave in a contract year will receive an amount equal to three times the current Substitute B rate.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers who take no personal leave in a contract year

clauses.quote: Teachers who take one personal leave day in a contract year will receive an amount equal to two times the current Substitute B rate.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers who take one personal leave day in a contract year

clauses.quote: Teachers who take two personal leave days in a contract year will receive an amount equal to the current Substitute B rate.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers who take two personal leave days in a contract year

clauses.quote: Teachers who take three or four personal days in a contract year will receive no additional amount.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers who take three or four personal days in a contract year
clauses.notes: States a conditional denial of payout rather than granting a right or imposing a duty.

clauses.quote: A minimum of one day (24 hours) notice must be given to the principal before taking personal leave, except in cases of emergency.
clauses.subject_text: A minimum of one day (24 hours) notice
clauses.notes: Passive construction implies a worker duty to provide advance notice.

clauses.quote: Personal Leave should not be taken the day before or after a school holiday (weekdays when school is not in session for students) or during the first or last week of school.
clauses.notes: Passive construction restricts worker scheduling of leave on specific days.

clauses.quote: Exceptions must have the prior approval of the school principal.
clauses.notes: Imposes a condition on workers seeking exceptions to scheduling limits.

clauses.quote: Limitations will be placed by the principal on the number who can take Personal Leave on any given day at that school.
clauses.notes: Passive voice; principal (management) is the implicit actor setting leave caps.

clauses.quote: Generally, only one or two Personal Leave days per school, per school day can be approved.
clauses.subject_text: only one or two Personal Leave days per school, per school day
clauses.notes: Sets a practical administrative cap on approved leave rather than a strict modal prohibition.

clauses.quote: Personal Leave will not be granted in connection with any form of job action or work stoppage.
clauses.notes: Passive voice; management is barred from granting leave during strikes or work stoppages.

clauses.quote: In emergency situations, teachers will be allowed to reimburse the district the cost of the substitute.
clauses.notes: Grants workers discretion to handle substitute costs during emergencies.

clauses.quote: The Human Resources Director will work with the Association on what constitutes an emergency.
Documentation should be provided within three working days from the time the employee reports back to work.
clauses.notes: Imposes a reporting/documentation duty on the employee.

clauses.quote: A maximum of three days would be allowed where an employee would be allowed to pay the cost of the substitute.
clauses.notes: Sets a hard cap on emergency leave days eligible for substitute cost payment.

clauses.quote: Routine unforeseen circumstances like car accidents, water heater breaks, and snowstorms will not be granted.
clauses.subject_text: Routine unforeseen circumstances like car accidents, water heater breaks, and snowstorms
clauses.notes: Passive voice; management is prohibited from granting emergency leave for routine issues.
